newsitem.title: UK: Arco may join Tengiz oil pact via LUKoil.
newsitem.headline: Arco may join Tengiz oil pact via LUKoil.

text.p: U.S. oil major Atlantic Richfield Co is likely to get involved in Chevron Corp's giant Tengiz oil project through its alliance with Russia's LUKoil, an Arco executive said on Monday.

"It is not a secret that Lukoil has been in discussion with Chevron and that Arco was likely to have a role in that undertaking through the Lukoil-Arco joint venture," said Ronald Arnault, Arco's executive vice president.
Arnault told reporters at the Oil and Money conference he was reluctant to discuss details because the venture requires Russian Central Bank approval.
"This approval is essential" and is currently under discussion in Moscow, he said.
LUKoil and Arco have an agreement to spend $3 billion on joint ventures in Russia and overseas, with most of the financing to come from Arco.
Just last week, the two companies announced their intention to work with Algerian state oil concern Sonatrach to tap Algerian hydrocarbon reserves.
LUKoil says a preliminary agreement has been reached with the Kazakh government under which LUKoil would buy a five percent stake in Chevron's Tengizchevroil (TCO).
Chevron owns 50 percent of TCO, Mobil Corp has 25 percent and the Kazakh government has 25 percent. The Tengiz field has estimated reserves of at least six billion barrels.
